jobs.job_description:
Meet the Team

This Cisco team drives all Lifecycle processes and systems anchored on delivering the best customer and partner experience. Our scope includes Market-to-Lead, Lead-to-Opportunity, Opportunity-to-Booking, Order-to-Cash, Onboard-to-Optimize, Escalate-to-Resolve, Renew-to-Booking, and Support-to-Advocacy. We offer a unique opportunity for dedicated, passionate, and highly creative engineers to have a wide-ranging impact on our development activities.

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer, you will serve as the critical architect bridging the gap between advanced AI/ML development and mission-critical IT Operations. You will be responsible for engineering and optimizing intelligent solutions that automate complex IT workflows, mitigate operational risk, and enable precise, automated root cause analysis. By operationalizing machine learning at scale, you will transform IT environments-reducing manual overhead, sharpening diagnostic accuracy, and accelerating operational velocity to ensure the uncompromising reliability and scalability of our global applications.

What You ll Do

Architect Innovate: Design, deploy, and maintain high-performance machine learning pipelines tailored to support mission-critical AI Technologies initiatives.

Automate Optimize: Drive operational efficiency by automating routine tasks and building robust CI/CD pipelines to streamline deployment workflows.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and Infrastructure/Operations teams to integrate AI-driven intelligence into existing IT ecosystems seamlessly.

Analyze Interpret: Evaluate complex network performance data to uncover actionable trends, detect anomalies, and identify strategic opportunities for system optimization.

Ensure System Reliability: Develop and manage proactive monitoring and alerting frameworks to maintain peak system health.

Resolve Refine: Troubleshoot and remediate complex issues within AI Technologies environments, ranging from configuration challenges to systemic service disruptions.

Measure Success: Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) to quantify the business impact and efficacy of AI Technologies implementations.

Stay Ahead of the Curve: Continuously explore emerging advancements in AI and machine learning, applying cutting-edge technologies to drive perpetual improvement.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with 2-4 years of relevant experience.

Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python) and modern automation frameworks.

Proven experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation.

Solid foundational knowledge of machine learning concepts and their practical application in real-world systems.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a demonstrated ability to identify trends in complex datasets.

Solid experience with Agile development process and ways of working - Jira, Github, Source Control Management.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to thrive in diverse, cross-functional technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

AI Systems Infrastructure: Direct experience with AI Technologies platforms and network assurance solutions, complemented by hands-on proficiency in cloud-based AI infrastructure, specifically AWS, Amazon Bedrock, and Azure OpenAI.

Cloud-Native Deployment: Demonstrated familiarity with cloud-native technologies and container orchestration, including Kubernetes and Docker, alongside proven experience in the end-to-end design and deployment of scalable machine learning models in production environments.

Technical Expertise: Comprehensive experience with AI-native development tools and intelligent agent architecture, including LangChain, LangSmith, GraphQL, FastAPI, MuleSoft Agent Broker, and related LLM orchestration and API integration technologies.

Why Cisco

At Cisco, we re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Born digital, UST transforms lives through the power of technology. We walk alongside our clients and partners, embedding innovation and agility into everything they do. We help them create transformative experiences and human-centered solutions for a better world.

The opportunity:

Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI and Agentic AI applications on AWS, leveraging services such as Amazon Bedrock and cloud-native architectures to deliver scalable, enterprise-grade AI solutions.

Develop, test, and optimize LLM-powered applications, including prompt engineering, context management, orchestration logic, memory frameworks, and agent-tool interactions to improve accuracy, performance, and user experience.

Collaborate with architecture, cloud, and DevOps teams to implement secure, scalable, and observable AI solutions following software engineering best practices, CI/CD standards, and enterprise governance requirements.

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required .

6 -7 year Industrial experience

1-2 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML application development

strong AWS cloud development expertise and practical experience using LangGraph, LangChain, Python, LLMs, Agentic AI.

Role Location: Remote-US

Compensation Range : $72,000-$108,000

Benefits

Full-time, regular employees accrue a minimum of 10 days of paid vacation per year, receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year), 10 paid holidays, and are eligible for paid bereavement leave and jury duty. They are eligible to participate in the Company s 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer matching. They and their dependents residing in the US are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as the following Company-paid Employee Only benefits: basic life insurance, accidental death and disability insurance, and short- and long-term disability benefits. Regular employees may purchase additional voluntary short-term disability benefits, and participate in a Health Savings Account (HSA) as well as a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for healthcare, dependent child care, and/or commuting expenses as allowable under IRS guidelines. Benefits offerings vary in Puerto Rico.

Part-time employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year) and are eligible to participate in the Company s 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer matching.

Full-time temporary employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year) and are eligible to participate in the Company s 401(k) program with employer matching. They and their dependents residing in the US are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance.

Part-time temporary employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year (pro-rated for new hires throughout the year).

All US employees who work in a state or locality with more generous paid sick leave benefits than specified here will receive the benefit of those sick leave laws.

We proudly embrace the values that have shaped UST since day one. We build our culture of Humility, Humanity, and Integrity. These values inspire us to nurture a people-first, human centric culture that fosters diversity, prioritizes sustainable solutions, and keeps our people and clients at the forefront of all decisions.

Humility:

We will listen, learn, be empathetic and help selflessly in our interactions with everyone.

We honor our commitments and act with responsibility in all our relationships.

Poaition: AI Agent Engineer

Reports to: Head of Engineering / CEO

Works with: Lead Developer, Plant Management, HR

Location: Pune, India

Type: Full-time, permanent

Experience: 3+ years software engineering, with hands-on LLM application work




Purpose of the role:

To own MetisEI's AI agent layer end-to-end. We are rolling out approximately 30 agents spanning production, supply chain, quality, HR and finance. Several are already live at CT Mexico. These agents send reports and instructions directly to line managers and plant staff, largely over WhatsApp so reliability is the job, not a nice-to-have.




Key responsibilities:

Design, build and maintain the agent layer production efficiency reporting, workforce and absence reporting, supply chain, quality and finance agents.
Enforce the deterministic/LLM boundary. All arithmetic, thresholds, bucketing, ranking and fixed content must be computed and validated in code. The LLM is used for natural language rewriting of a pre-verified output only.
Build and maintain automated test suites and evaluation harnesses for every agent. Agents must be regression-tested before any prompt or logic change reaches a live recipient.
Build output validation that blocks a message from sending if it fails its rules, rather than relying on the model to comply.
Configure and operate the WhatsApp Business Platform (Meta Cloud API) business account and number setup, message template submission and approval, webhook handling, delivery and read receipts, error and retry handling, opt-in management, rate limits and quality rating.
Build scheduled delivery pipelines (daily and weekly cadences, timezone-correct per site) including PDF report generation and attachment.
Work directly with plant management and HR to specify agent behaviour, then translate that into testable rules.
Maintain a versioned content library (tips, templates, standard messaging) with verbatim-copy guarantees where required.



Essential requirements:

Strong Python. This role writes real software, not just prompts.
Hands-on production experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI or equivalent) not experimental or personal-project only.
Demonstrable experience building evaluation and testing frameworks for non-deterministic systems.
Practical understanding of where LLMs fail and how to constrain them structured output, validation, guardrails, fallbacks.
WhatsApp Business Platform / Meta Cloud API configuration experience, or equivalent messaging platform integration (Twilio, SMS gateways) with clear ability to pick up WhatsApp specifics.
Webhook and asynchronous job/scheduling experience.
Ability to work with non-technical stakeholders and convert loose requirements into precise, testable rules.



Desirable:

PDF and report generation.
Retrieval-augmented generation and vector databases (Qdrant).
Manufacturing or operations domain exposure.
Spanish.
